source: NCERT Class VIII, Curiosity: Textbook of Science, Ch. 9.

sections.heading: 1. Solutions, Solutes and Solvents
points: A **solution** = a **homogeneous mixture** of two or more substances.
**Solute** = the substance that **dissolves** (usually the smaller amount, e.g. sugar/salt).
**Solvent** = the substance in which the solute dissolves (usually the larger amount, e.g. water).
**Solution = Solute + Solvent** (e.g. sugar + water = sugar solution). **Water = universal solvent**.

sections.heading: 2. Solubility and Saturation
points: **Soluble** substances dissolve (sugar, salt); **insoluble** do not (sand, chalk).
**Solubility** = the maximum amount of a solute that dissolves in a given solvent at a given temperature.
**Unsaturated** — more solute can still dissolve; **Saturated** — no more can dissolve at that temperature; **Supersaturated** — holds more than usual (unstable).
**Heating usually increases** the solubility of solids; **gases dissolve better in cold** water.

sections.heading: 3. Concentration
points: **Concentration** = how much solute is present in a given amount of solution.
A **dilute** solution has little solute; a **concentrated** solution has much solute.
Concentration can be changed by adding **more solute** or **more solvent**.

sections.heading: 4. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Solution = homogeneous mixture; solute (dissolves) + solvent (dissolving medium).
Water = universal solvent.
Soluble (sugar/salt) vs insoluble (sand); solubility = max solute that dissolves at a temperature.
Saturated = no more dissolves; heating dissolves more solid; gases dissolve better when cold.
Concentration = amount of solute per solution; dilute vs concentrated.

sections.heading: 5. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **solute** dissolves; the **solvent** is what it dissolves in (water is the common solvent).
A **saturated** solution can dissolve **no more** solute at that temperature.
**Heating** increases the solubility of most **solids** but **decreases** that of **gases**.
A **solution** is a **homogeneous** (uniform) mixture.
